# API Requirements Checklist: GymTracker v1

**Purpose**: Validate that the REST contract is internally consistent, that its conventions are stated as rules rather than inferred from examples, and that it traces back to functional requirements in the spec.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/rest-api.md](../contracts/rest-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the error response shape stated as a functional requirement, or does it exist only in the contract? [Traceability, Spec §FR-036 vs Contract §Error shape] — resolved by FR-036c
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for reporting multiple simultaneous validation failures, or is only the first failing field returned? [Gap, Contract §Error shape] — resolved by FR-036d: first failing field only, with the reasoning stated
- [x] CHK003 Is the notation for nested field paths in error responses defined by rule rather than by a single example? [Clarity, Contract §Error shape] — resolved: Contract §Error shape now states the dotted-path and zero-based-index rule
- [x] CHK004 Are request body size limits and content-type requirements specified? [Gap] — resolved by FR-036e (JSON only, 1 MB)
- [x] CHK005 Is the health endpoint traceable to any functional requirement? [Traceability, Contract §Health] — resolved by FR-035b
- [x] CHK006 Is the food-edit restriction mechanism traceable to a requirement about editing foods with existing entries? [Traceability, Contract §Foods vs Spec §FR-024] — resolved by FR-024c, FR-024d
- [x] CHK007 Is an API versioning strategy documented, or explicitly recorded as out of scope? [Gap] — resolved: explicitly out of scope in Contract §Conventions and §Assumptions
- [x] CHK008 Are concurrency requirements defined for full-replacement updates, given that two tabs could overwrite each other? [Gap, Contract §Workouts] — resolved by FR-039b: last write wins, no coordination, stated deliberately
- [x] CHK009 Is the behavior for unknown query parameters specified, as the behavior for unknown body fields is? [Gap, Contract §Conventions] — resolved: unknown query parameters are ignored, matching body fields

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are default and maximum result limits consistent across list endpoints, or is the difference between them justified? [Consistency, Contract §Workouts, §Foods] — resolved: Contract §Conventions explains the history-versus-search distinction
- [x] CHK011 Are date-range parameters applied consistently — optional on some endpoints, required on others? [Consistency, Contract §Workouts, §Progress] — resolved: Contract §Conventions states the rule and why progress requires a range
- [x] CHK012 Is the choice between 400 and 404 consistent for unknown identifiers supplied in a request body versus a path? [Ambiguity, Contract §Meal entries, §Workouts] — resolved by the 400-versus-404 rule in Contract §Conventions
- [x] CHK013 Are idempotency expectations stated consistently across archive, restore, and delete operations? [Consistency, Contract §Exercises, §Body weight] — resolved: Contract §Conventions states which verbs are idempotent and why DELETE deliberately is not
- [x] CHK014 Is the use of `PUT` versus `PATCH` governed by a stated rule across resources? [Consistency, Contract §Workouts, §Body weight, §Goals] — resolved: rule added to Contract §Conventions
- [x] CHK015 Are resource identifiers consistent in kind — numeric ids for some resources, dates for others — with the distinction explained? [Consistency, Contract §Body weight, §Goals] — resolved: Contract §Conventions explains date-as-identity
- [x] CHK016 Do the conflict conditions returned as 409 correspond exactly to the duplicate and reference rules in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004b vs Contract] — resolved: the error table now enumerates exactly three 409 cases, each traced to an FR
- [x] CHK017 Is the future-date restriction applied consistently, with the goal-effective-date exception stated in the requirements rather than only in research? [Consistency, Research §R10 vs Spec §Requirements] — resolved by FR-049

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK018 Is "unknown fields are ignored, not rejected" stated as a binding rule for every endpoint? [Clarity, Contract §Conventions] — verified: stated once in §Conventions, which governs all endpoints, and now extended to query parameters
- [x] CHK019 Is the meaning of a null `goals` object distinguished clearly from a goal set whose values happen to be zero? [Clarity, Contract §Nutrition day view, Spec §FR-028] — verified: the contract requires `null` rather than zero-filling, precisely so the two cannot be confused
- [x] CHK020 Is the `exceeded` flag's relationship to a negative `remaining` value defined unambiguously for the boundary case of exact equality? [Ambiguity, Contract §Nutrition day view, Spec §FR-027] — resolved: strictly `consumed > goal`, so hitting a goal exactly is not exceeded (FR-027a)
- [x] CHK021 Is "case-insensitive substring match" precise about accent handling, trimming, and multi-word queries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017] — resolved by FR-017a (trimmed, no accent folding, substring on name)
- [x] CHK022 Is the confirmation token for the destructive reset specified as an exact, case-sensitive value? [Clarity, Contract §Demo] — resolved by FR-041d

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for requests referencing an archived exercise or food? [Coverage, Contract §Workouts, §Meal entries] — resolved by FR-004d plus the contract's 400 responses for archived identifiers
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a progress request whose range contains no days at all? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-030b] — resolved by FR-030b and FR-034
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for the response when a resource exists but has no associated child records? [Coverage] — resolved: Contract §Conventions requires an empty array, never `null` or `404`
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for how the API behaves when the database is unavailable mid-request? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-038] — resolved by FR-038g

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK027 Is the absence of authentication stated as a deliberate requirement with its security consequence acknowledged? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039] — resolved: FR-039 now names the consequence and FR-039a states the mitigation
- [x] CHK028 Are rate limiting and request throttling explicitly excluded rather than silently omitted? [Gap] — resolved: excluded in Contract §Conventions and §Assumptions
- [x] CHK029 Is the performance target expressed in terms the API can be measured against, rather than only screen render time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007] — resolved by SC-007a (under 200 ms server-side)
- [x] CHK030 Is the requirement that internal error detail never reaches the client stated in the spec, not only in the constitution? [Traceability, Spec §FR-038 vs Constitution §V] — resolved by FR-038f

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
